name: Return Strategy
summary: This EA implements a mean reversion strategy that enters trades when price deviates significantly from a central moving average or equilibrium level, expecting a return to the mean. It identifies overextended market conditions and places counter-trend trades with defined take-profit targets at or near the mean. The strategy includes basic risk management with stop-loss and lot sizing controls.
summary_zh: 该EA实现均值回归策略，当价格显著偏离中心移动平均线或均衡水平时入场交易，预期价格将回归均值。它识别过度延伸的市场条件，并在均值附近设置反趋势交易和明确的获利目标。策略包含基本的止损和手数控制风险管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于均值回归原理，假设价格偏离均值后会回归。入场条件通常是价格触及布林带外轨或偏离移动平均线超过设定的阈值倍数后开反向仓。出场条件包括价格回归到均值线时止盈，以及止损设在偏离更远处作为保护。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面设有最大持仓限制和单笔风险控制。整体策略在震荡行情中表现较好，但在趋势行情中可能连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the mean reversion principle, assuming that price will return to the mean after deviating from it. Entry conditions typically involve price reaching Bollinger Band outer bands or deviating beyond a set threshold multiple from the moving average, then opening a counter-trend position. Exit conditions include take-profit when price returns to the mean line, and stop-loss placed further out as protection. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or equity-proportional lot calculation. Money management includes maximum position limits and per-trade risk controls. The overall strategy performs well in ranging markets but may incur consecutive losses during trending conditions.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于识别订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number; 0 manages all positions

pros: 均值回归逻辑在震荡市中有较好的胜率
设有止损保护，单笔风险可控
参数可调，适应不同品种和周期
回撤相对趋势策略在震荡期更小
策略概念清晰，易于理解和优化
pros_en: Mean reversion logic has good win rate in ranging markets
Stop-loss protection keeps per-trade risk controlled
Adjustable parameters adapt to different instruments and timeframes
Relatively smaller drawdown than trend strategies during choppy periods
Clear strategy concept, easy to understand and optimize
cons: 趋势行情中可能连续逆势亏损
均值回归假设不一定始终成立
缺乏趋势过滤机制可能导致不必要的逆势交易
震荡判断不足可能在趋势初期就入场
固定参数难以适应市场状态切换
cons_en: May incur consecutive counter-trend losses during trending markets
Mean reversion assumption does not always hold true
Lack of trend filter may cause unnecessary counter-trend entries
Insufficient ranging confirmation may enter at trend onset
Fixed parameters struggle to adapt to market regime changes
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标如ADX，避免在强趋势中逆势开仓
加入自适应参数机制，根据波动率动态调整偏差阈值和止损距离
增加多时间周期确认，提高入场信号的可靠性
improvements_en: Add trend filter indicator like ADX to avoid counter-trend entries in strong trends
Implement adaptive parameter mechanism to dynamically adjust deviation thresholds and stop-loss distances based on volatility
Add multi-timeframe confirmation to improve entry signal reliability

risk_points: 缺乏趋势状态识别可能在强趋势中连续逆势亏损
均值回归策略在极端行情下可能面临较大回撤
未检测是否有新K线形成可能导致同一信号重复开仓
risk_points_en: Lack of trend state identification may cause consecutive counter-trend losses in strong trends
Mean reversion strategy may face significant drawdown during extreme market conditions
No new bar check may cause repeated entries on the same signal
